description: Interpolated velocity, pressure, or velocity-gradient values at up to 10 points and a single time in a Johns Hopkins Turbulence Databases (JHTDB) reference DNS/LES dataset. Values are returned in the dataset's native simulation units (dimensionless DNS code units for the isotropic/channel/MHD datasets; physical meters/seconds for the atmospheric-boundary-layer and wind-farm LES datasets) — call jhtdb_datasets first to see a dataset's domain and time range. Uses JHTDB's public testing authorization token, capped well under its documented small-query allowance.

points.description: 1 to 10 points, each {x, y, z} in the dataset's native spatial units.

spatial_interpolation.description: Spatial interpolation kernel. Defaults to Lag4 for velocity/pressure, None_Fd4 (4th-order finite difference, no interpolation) for velocity_gradient.

time.description: Simulation time at which to evaluate the field, within the dataset's time range from jhtdb_datasets.

name: jhtdb_point_query
title: Jhtdb Point Query
